extracted.name: Panko-Crusted Air Fryer Mahi Mahi
extracted.description: Cook breaded mahi mahi fillets in your air fryer for tender, flaky fish with an everything-seasoned panko crust that’s got the most delightful crunch.
instruction_lines: Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix panko, bagel seasoning, garlic salt, turmeric, and pepper together in a shallow dish.
Place mahi mahi fillets onto a platter and drizzle with grapeseed oil. Dip each fillet into the panko mixture to coat, then place in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Spray with nonstick spray.
Cook in the preheated air fryer until fish flakes easily with a fork, 12 to 15 minutes, flipping halfway through. Remove from the air fryer.
Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges. Serve immediately.
